title: nf-core/oncoseq pipeline - params.input schema
description: Schema for the file provided with params.input

project.errorMessage: Parent sequencing project name must be provided and cannot contain spaces

sample.errorMessage: Sample name must be provided and cannot contain spaces

purity.errorMessage: Aprroximate tumor purity must be provided for each sample in the form of a fraction, from 0 to 1 (1 being 100% pure).

filter.errorMessage: Must be set to true to pre-process reads by filtering out longer reads or to false to skip this step
